_comment: ZeRO-2: shards optimizer state + gradients, replicates parameters.
The default for LoRA runs (SFT and GRPO) — only the adapter has gradients,
so there is little optimizer state to shard, and keeping full parameters on
each rank means generate() during GRPO rollouts needs no param gathering.
Fits a 32B LoRA run on 80GB cards; use zero3 for 72B or full finetuning.
